figures.caption: Figure 1: The overall framework of the proposed DSIRM, which models discrete semantic identifiers via query-bridged contrastive quantization. The framework consists of three main components: (1) Item SID learning through contrastive RQ-VAE, (2) Query SID generation via LLM-based prediction, and (3) Hierarchical SID matching for relevance scoring.
Table 2: Ablation study on proposed components.
